summary: Re-requested the core probe after its compile failure. The receipt (edcf4b39cbad41a7ac3c79afdcfd3d1f, status error) shows the first attempt never ran: rustc rejected the harness with E0384 — `drop_accepted` was assigned inside `collect` without being mutable — so it produced no test observations and no verdict on the question. The harness now takes `mut drop_accepted`; nothing else changed (same two-node deterministic simulation, same three cases: drop exactly the follower's Accepted over a 500-step/100-resend-period window, the delivered-receipt control, and the later-proposal repair), and the experiment is submitted with previous_id and a revision_reason limited to the compile fix. The event-backpressure account is untouched and stays supported by receipt ff4511e8f6684444b8b1ec403335f9f8 citing parsed events 2/3/4 against control events 0/1. Local verification of the fixed harness did not finish in this turn — building the omnipaxos test target's dev-dependencies (kompact and friends) exceeded the local window — so the executed receipt is what will settle whether the lost-Accepted entry really stays undecided with no timer-driven repair.
